title: Sort Colors
description: Sort an array of 0s, 1s, and 2s in-place using the Dutch National Flag algorithm.

data.text: Given an array `nums` with `n` objects colored red (0), white (1), or blue (2), sort them in-place so objects of the same color are adjacent.
Count zeros, ones, and twos, then overwrite the array. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Counting Sort O(n)

data.text: Maintain three regions (0s, 1s, 2s) with three pointers. O(n) time, O(1) space, single pass.

data.title: Dutch Flag O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) both ways. **Space:** O(1). Counting sort uses a fixed-size counter array; the Dutch flag does it in one pass with three pointers and is the classic interview answer.
